blocks.x: A working definition of Industrial Equipment & Machinery for Manufacturing & Industrial: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.

Before proposing anything, we map the context Industrial Equipment & Machinery will run in — regulators, decision cadence, existing contracts — because the design that ignores context fails at the gate.
